description: Switches a maintenance window off (active: false) or back on (active: true). Off, it stops suppressing its monitors and its schedule stops; on, a manual window starts maintenance immediately and a scheduled one follows its schedule again. It acts on a maintenance window; to stop a monitor's checks use setMonitorActive. Find the ID with listMaintenanceWindows.

active.description: false switches the window off, true switches it on

maintenanceID.description: The ID of the maintenance window to switch

name: setMaintenanceActive
title: Set Maintenance Active
